Re-case the three capstones on a variant the lessons do not work (for example a different contact, a different side-track toe, a different booking target), which keeps every field and its tolerance; scrubbing the lessons instead would remove the course's own worked narrative. A re-cased calibration and history total then need a learner-settable surface (a contact or booking input on StructureExplorer, a bisection readout), because kriging bisection is engine-only.
